an5.107:1.1: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu with five qualities is worthy of offerings dedicated to the gods, worthy of hospitality, worthy of a religious donation, worthy of veneration with cupped palms, and is the supreme field of merit for the world.
an5.107:2.2: It’s when a bhikkhu is accomplished in ethics, concentration, wisdom, freedom, and the knowledge and vision of freedom.
an5.107:3.1: A bhikkhu with these five qualities is worthy of offerings dedicated to the gods, worthy of hospitality, worthy of a religious donation, worthy of veneration with cupped palms, and is the supreme field of merit for the world.”
